source.selection_reason: Urban MV benchmark load mix as an initial mixed-background proxy. Second Sunday of May2016 through the following Thursday, selected before power-flow results, matching the second-Sunday-of-May2024 start and Sun-Thu structure of the existing Azure window. Not the same year, place, timezone or measured correlation.
source.aggregation: Sum of donor active-load ratings times their assigned relative active-load profiles; in-service loads and original scaling only. Donor network, voltage, generators and reactive profiles are NOT transferred.
source.license: SimBench database ODbL; individual contents DbCL; retain attribution on derived profile exports.

alignment.mapping: Hold each 15-minute value over three 5-minute intervals; trim the first and last5-minute intervals of the5-day block. Source timestamps are naive scenario labels, not converted to UTC.
alignment.phase_sensitivity: Circularly shift the retained1438-value background vector by72steps (6h), preserving its exact energy/distribution. This is a synthetic phase test; wrap seam and weekday alignment are not physical.

spatial_mapping: One common nonnegative multiplier applies to every original IEEE33 P and Q load, preserving each bus power factor and the original spatial P/Q shares. The additional AIDC load is explicitly excluded. No claim of measured nodal diversity.
extra_diagnostic: At every no-storage violating point, try maximum instantaneous ESS/TES discharge ignoring SOC and duration. If it still fails, rated active-only storage cannot remove that violation on this tested operating branch; if it passes, no feasible multiperiod schedule is implied.
solver: Balanced quasi-steady AC BFSW; independent Newton-Raphson checks at voltage/current/head extrema and failure points. No high-frequency waveform reconstruction.
